name: boardreadyops
description: BoardReadyOps checks KiCad hardware repositories for production readiness before fabrication.
author: Osman Aslan

scripts.lint: biome check . && corepack pnpm run i18n:check && corepack pnpm run verify:public-surface
scripts.test:action: corepack pnpm run build && vitest run tests/action
scripts.test:a11y: vitest run tests/unit/report/html.test.ts tests/unit/scripts/check-docs-a11y.test.ts && corepack pnpm run docs:a11y
scripts.coverage: corepack pnpm run build && vitest run --coverage tests/unit tests/action tests/property tests/snapshot
scripts.verify:dist: node scripts/verify-dist.mjs && corepack pnpm run check:size
scripts.docs: node scripts/compatibility.mjs render && node scripts/generate-rule-docs.mjs && node scripts/update-action-inputs-docs.mjs && corepack pnpm run api:docs && corepack pnpm run release:history && node scripts/docs-build.mjs
scripts.verify: corepack pnpm run lint && corepack pnpm run typecheck && corepack pnpm run knip && corepack pnpm run compatibility:check && corepack pnpm run build && corepack pnpm run verify:dist && corepack pnpm run verify:version && corepack pnpm run verify:marketplace && corepack pnpm run test:unit && corepack pnpm run test:property && corepack pnpm run test:snapshot && corepack pnpm run test:action && corepack pnpm run test:a11y && corepack pnpm run coverage && corepack pnpm run verify:structure && corepack pnpm run gc && corepack pnpm run docs && corepack pnpm run security
scripts.security: corepack pnpm run licenses:check && corepack pnpm run notice:check && corepack pnpm run check:reuse
scripts.renovate:post-upgrade: corepack pnpm run deps:install-ci && corepack pnpm run notice && corepack pnpm run build
scripts.generated:check: corepack pnpm run notice:check && corepack pnpm run compatibility:check
scripts.verify:release: corepack pnpm run verify && corepack pnpm run verify:release-channels && corepack pnpm run verify:clean-tree
scripts.cloud:typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @boardreadyops/contracts typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @boardreadyops/cloud-core typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @boardreadyops/db typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @boardreadyops/web typecheck
scripts.cloud:build: corepack pnpm --filter @boardreadyops/web build && corepack pnpm run verify:web-standalone && corepack pnpm run verify:control-plane-worker-boundary && corepack pnpm run verify:transition-writers
scripts.workflow:lint: node scripts/toolchain.mjs run pre-commit run actionlint --all-files && node scripts/toolchain.mjs run pre-commit run zizmor --all-files
scripts.verify:all: node scripts/toolchain.mjs run corepack pnpm run verify:all:inner
scripts.verify:all:inner: node scripts/toolchain.mjs doctor --strict && corepack pnpm run verify && corepack pnpm run test:int:monorepo && corepack pnpm run cloud:typecheck && corepack pnpm run cloud:build && corepack pnpm run workflow:lint && corepack pnpm run coverage:cloud && corepack pnpm run verify:summary
scripts.coverage:core: corepack pnpm run build && node scripts/run-codecov-coverage.mjs
scripts.coverage:all: corepack pnpm run coverage:core && corepack pnpm run coverage:cloud
scripts.deps:install-ci: corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && corepack pnpm rebuild @prisma/engines esbuild prisma sharp
scripts.deps:install-web: corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts --filter @boardreadyops/web... --filter boardreadyops && corepack pnpm rebuild @prisma/engines esbuild prisma sharp
